answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats block fakes. Each agent posts one live heartbeat per epoch, umber-stamped and bound to one fingerprint; no nebula of fakes can hide. The beacon audits a random 5% sample; failed heartbeats slash the deposit and freeze the slot 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 2,000 POA per epoch against at most 20 POA each: a losing attack. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep full rewards, like a juniper ring.
